# FitMind

> FitMind is a science-based mental fitness platform combining meditation apps, neuroscience research, and expert podcasts to train attention and build psychological resilience.

FitMind offers guided meditation training grounded in neuroscience, cognitive psychology, and contemplative philosophy. The platform features an interactive meditation app, a podcast series with expert interviews on mindfulness and brain science, and educational content on mental fitness techniques for modern life.

## Key Topics

- Meditation
- Mental Fitness
- Neuroscience
- Mindfulness
- Attention Training
- Neuroplasticity
- Mental Health
- Meditation App
- Brain Science

## Core Platform

- [FitMind: Science-Based Mental Fitness](https://fitmind.org): FitMind homepage introducing meditation app and mental fitness training
- [Meditate](https://fitmind.org/meditate): FitMind app meditation platform with guided meditations and techniques
- [The FitMind Podcast: Mental Health, Psychology & Mindfulness Meditation](https://fitmind.org/learn): FitMind Podcast featuring expert interviews on meditation and neuroscience

## Meditation Science & Techniques

- [Stages of Attention in Meditation](https://fitmind.org/blog-collection/stages-attention-meditation): Guide to meditation stages and attention development progression
- [How Attention Works](https://fitmind.org/blog-collection/how-attention-works): Guide explaining attention mechanics and neuroscience of focus
- [Psychology of Meditation: How the Mind Works](https://fitmind.org/blog-collection/psychology-meditation-how-mind-works): Guide to meditation psychology and how the mind works
- [Self-Directed Neuroplasticity](https://fitmind.org/blog-collection/self-directed-neuroplasticity): Guide on neuroplasticity and meditation techniques for brain training
- [Progress in Meditation](https://fitmind.org/blog-collection/progress-in-meditation): Beginner's guide to meditation progress and mental fitness tracking

## Podcast Episodes

- [Evolution of Meditation: AI, VR & Neurofeedback](https://fitmind.org/podcast/evolution-of-meditation-ai-vr-neurofeedback): Podcast episode on meditation tech evolution with AI and neurofeedback
- [Science of Letting Go in Meditation](https://fitmind.org/podcast/science-of-letting-go-meditation): Podcast episode on letting go meditation and consciousness science
- [Ethics of Meditation](https://fitmind.org/podcast/ethics-of-meditation): Podcast episode on meditation ethics and evidence-based contemplative practice
- [Rites of Passage](https://fitmind.org/podcast/rites-of-passage): Podcast episode exploring rites of passage and meditation for resilience

## Mental Health & Wellness

- [Medical Benefits of Meditation](https://fitmind.org/blog-collection/medical-benefits-meditation): Article on scientific medical benefits of meditation and brain health
- [The Loneliness Epidemic](https://fitmind.org/blog-collection/loneliness-epidemic): Article on loneliness epidemic and mental fitness in digital age
- [Screenome and Digital Hygiene](https://fitmind.org/blog-collection/screenome-meaning): Article on screenome and digital hygiene impact on mental health
- [Stoic Mindset](https://fitmind.org/blog-collection/stoic-mindset): Article on stoic philosophy and ancient wisdom for mental training
- [Stories and Narratives of Mind](https://fitmind.org/blog-collection/stories-narratives-of-mind): Guide on narrative bias and cognitive psychology for self-awareness

## Support & Community
